headline: STAY on X.1
why: No X.1 trade today: the bot started at 10:24 ET, after the 09:35-09:40 entry window. Had it run, X.1 would have shorted the red opening candle at 26165 and been stopped at 09:54 (-1R, about -$318) before a ~1,200-pt sell-off. Two live trades so far, both -1R; far too few to judge, so no change.
